questionText:
Which source from 1857 published an illustration with the caption, "The
news of the terrible massacre at Cawnpore (Kanpur) produced an outburst
of fiery indignation and wild desire for revenge throughout the whole of
England"?

options.text: London News
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Justice, Punch
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Syllabus Core.

options.text: The Times of India
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: London Mirror
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Syllabus Core (Social Histories of Early Societies (Kinship, Caste and Class)):
In NCERT Theme 11, Figure 11.11 features an allegorical illustration titled 'Justice, Punch, 12 September 1857'. The textbook text quotes the caption: 'The news of the terrible massacre at Cawnpore produced an outburst of fiery indignation and wild desire for revenge throughout the whole of England.' The cartoon depicted Justice as a colossal, aggressive classical goddess wielding a sword and shield, trampling Indian sepoys underfoot.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
